wiki_article:
**Mind Control Poems: Complete Blog Archive** is a dataset by Lee Sharks, deposited 29 April 2026, holding the complete archive of `mindcontrolpoems.blogspot.com`.

The blog is the original publishing surface for Lee Sharks and the ground on which the Crimson Hexagonal Archive, the Semantic Economy framework, the New Human project and the heteronym system were first worked out. Depositing it whole converts an author's running platform into a fixed, citable object with a manifestation history and verification block.

The deposit acquired unexpected evidentiary weight later. The 2026-07-19 restoration campaign treated the blog as canonical HEAD and recovered many terminated works from it — a doctrine that proved wrong in an identifiable class, since works drafted on the blog and *then developed* into deposits were seated in their earlier state. #434 held the blog rendering of the Non-Indexed Perfective at 20,305 characters against an authorial file of 27,673. The blog is the archive's most important recovery source and the origin of its draft-over-deposit defect, both.
